en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Jazzaki who said,

‘I wrote to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> asking him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who married a virgin girl, so he found her as having been married before, and for her is the dower. Should he be loyal (to the dower) or reduced (amount)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Reduced’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Jazzak who has said the following:

“I once wrote to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and asked about the case of a man who married a virgin girl but found out that she was not virgin if it was obligatory to pay complete mahr (dower) or less. He (the Imam) answered, ‘It is less.’”
